name: Daily Sales Report
description: Automatically queries yesterday's orders from the database each morning, analyzes performance against weekly and monthly targets using AI, and emails a formatted summary report to management. Designed for e-commerce stores and B2B sales teams who need daily visibility without manual reporting effort.

config.query: SELECT o.id, o.total_amount, o.status, p.name AS product_name, c.email AS customer_email FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' AND o.created_at < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC

config.expression: { totalRevenue: sum(input, 'total_amount'), orderCount: len(input), topProducts: groupBy(input, 'product_name') | sortDesc('total_amount') | take(5) }

config.prompt:
You are a business analyst for an e-commerce company.
Analyze the following daily sales data and provide a concise performance summary.

Data:
- Total Revenue: {{totalRevenue}}
- Order Count: {{orderCount}}
- Top Products: {{topProducts}}

Include:
1. Revenue trend vs. yesterday
2. Top-performing product category
3. Any anomalies or patterns worth noting
4. One actionable recommendation

Keep the tone professional and data-driven. Format as bullet points.

config.template:
Daily Sales Report - {{date}}

Total Revenue: ${{totalRevenue}}

Orders: {{orderCount}}

Top Products

    {{#each topProducts}}
  • {{this.name}}: ${{this.revenue}}
    • {{/each}}

AI Analysis

{{aiAnalysis}}
